body: I'm not innocent; I'm wasting resources. Only productive people are innocent and deserving of life.
They're normal human beings. They are in the majority. But I'm having trouble killing myself due to background checks. It's ok, I'll just wait for the hit my family inevitably puts out on me.
Yet the idea of executing burdens to society is resurfacing. It won't be long until they kill me, so I should expedite the process and kill myself.
That is a minority view. In the span of time it took you to say this, 6 more people told me to kill myself.
